body:
## Breezy cotton dresses with Jaipur prints

Block printed cotton dresses are among the most popular Indian styles with buyers in the USA, UK, Europe and Australia. They are light, breathable and every print feels handcrafted.

## Styles we make

- Maxi dresses – tiered, wrap and halter neck
- Midi and short dresses
- Kaftans and resort wear
- Matching co-ord sets

## Prints and fabrics

Floral block prints, Bagru, Dabu, indigo and Sanganeri designs on cotton, cambric, mulmul and voile.

## For international buyers

We ship worldwide with commercial invoices. Export orders are prepaid using the secure payment method confirmed in the written quotation/order review. [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) with your requirement.

faq.q: Do you make dresses in western sizes?
faq.a: Yes. We can follow your size chart, including US and UK sizing, for bulk orders.
Yes, many styles can be made in extended sizes. Share your size range when you enquire.
